title: Cap Kingdom

{{Course infobox |image=[[File:SMO Art - Cap Kingdom.jpg|280px]] |missions=[[Cappy of the Cap Kingdom]] |boss=[[Topper]] |moons=31 |regional_coins=50 |previous=[[Mushroom Kingdom (Super Mario Odyssey)|Mushroom Kingdom]] (post-game) |next=[[Cascade Kingdom]] |directory=[[Super Mario Odyssey#Kingdoms|''Super Mario Odyssey'' kingdoms]] }} {{quote|Doesn't the moonlight just put you at ease?|Bonneter|Super Mario Odyssey}} The '''Cap Kingdom''' is the first kingdom visited in ''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]''. It is a gloomy, monochromatic kingdom filled with thick fog inhabited by hat-like beings called [[Bonneter]]s, including [[Cappy]] and his sister, [[Tiara]]. The resident Bonneters excel at ship-building and can even attach sails to their homes to convert them into airships. This kingdom also serves as the tutorial stage of the game, and is the greater location of '''Bonneton'''. Bonneton is possibly the joining of "Bonnet" (a type of headgear) and the city-name suffix "-ton". The Cap Kingdom island is located west of the [[Cascade Kingdom]] and northeast of the [[Mushroom Kingdom (Super Mario Odyssey)|Mushroom Kingdom]]. Geographically, the kingdom is a top hat-shaped island covered in black vegetation, soil and ground. As the name Cap Kingdom implies, hat-shaped buildings and reliefs are everywhere in this land of tradition and formality. [[File: TAoSMO Concept London Cap Kingdom.jpg|thumb|250px|The kingdom in ''The Art of Super Mario Odyssey'']] As shown in ''[[The Art of Super Mario Odyssey]]'', this kingdom is based on the real-world location of [[London]], [[United Kingdom|England]], particularly the {{wp|Victorian era}}, due to the architecture visible in the background, the {{wp|Pea soup fog|misty environment}}, and the clothing worn by the residents of the town. The residents also use many stock British expressions and hat-themed parodies. ==History== Sometime before ''Super Mario Odyssey'' starts, Bowser attacked the Cap Kingdom, kidnapping Tiara and damaging all of the airships. When [[Mario]] is knocked off [[Bowser's Airship]], he lands in a hilly area of Bonneton. When he gets up, he scares off the curious Cappy. Cappy calms down just past the [[Glasses Bridge]] of Bonneton. After a short conversation, they decide to join together to rescue [[Princess Peach]] and Tiara from [[Bowser]]. Cappy takes the place of [[Mario Cap|Mario's torn up cap]], transforming into a replica. With the airships of the Cap Kingdom broken, Cappy then determines that they have to travel to the [[Cascade Kingdom]] to find one, and that there is a way over at the top of [[Top-Hat Tower]]. He is unable to do so alone because the [[Broodals]] are up there. From the Central Plaza, Mario and Cappy go to Top-Hat Tower. They have to activate a bridge to cross a gap, and encounter three aggressive [[Mini Goomba]]s at the entrance. Inside the Top-Hat Tower, Mario learns to [[Capture]] by capturing a frog, and uses it to reach the higher exit. After climbing through the Top-Hat Tower and reaching its summit, the Broodals introduce themselves and [[Topper]] drops down to fight Mario. After being defeated, a [[Spark pylon]] appears. Mario captures this spark pylon so that he and Cappy can dash over to the Cascade Kingdom. ==Concept and creation== [[File:SMO Concept Art - Bonneton.jpg|thumb|left|Concept art of Bonneton]] [[File:SMO Concept Art - Bonneton Lamppost.jpg|thumb|Concept art of the lampposts of Bonneton]] With the Cap Kingdom being the first place that players visit after Mario's defeat in the opening cinematic, this world's strange and slightly disturbing environment was intended to reflect the player's feelings as they dive into this new game.{{cite|author=Sakai, Kazuya, et al.|date=November 5, 2019|format=First English Edition|title=''[[The Art of Super Mario Odyssey]]''|publisher=[[Dark Horse Books]]|isbn=978-1-50671-375-5|page=50}} Bonneton was designed incorporating a silk hat-like design in various objects, with the lawn also recalling the felt of the hats.{{cite|author=mario_odysseyJP|url=x.com/mario_odysseyJP/status/975489270633951233|date=March 18, 2018|title=こちらは帽子の国「カブロン」のコンセプトアート。いろいろな所にシルクハットのデザインを取り入れているのが特徴です。実は…芝の質感も帽子のフェルトをイメージしているんですよ。月が印象的に見えるように色の数も絞りました！|publisher=X|language=ja|accessdate=November 17, 2024}} A reduced number of colors was used in the design to make the moon look impressive. The concept art shows that in the early design the undulating city in the background was already there, along with the airship of the Broodals and the [[spark pylon]] leading to Fossil Falls. On the other hand, the [[Top-Hat Tower]] was meant to have a small tower with another top hat on top stemming from the main building, as well as two windows that looked like eyes. The entrance to it looked like a statue of Bowser with a top hat, while the Bonneters had a body and a head, with eyes not being incorporated in the hats. The lampposts were based on hat racks with three hats on them rather than just one,{{cite|author=mario_odysseyJP|language=ja|url=x.com/mario_odysseyJP/status/978386360435445760|date=March 26, 2018|title=帽子の国「カブロン」の街灯のラフスケッチです。帽子掛けをモチーフに、国のイメージに合うようにデザインしていきました。都市の国の街灯と差を出すために、曲線的なシルエットにしているんです！|publisher=X|accessdate=November 17, 2024}} and had a curved main stem to distinguish them from [[:File:SMO Metro Brochure G.png|street lights]] from [[Metro Kingdom]] and fit Bonneton. {{br}} ==Brochure details== {{SMO kingdom |subtitle=Home of Tradition, Propriety, and Hats |image=SMO Cap Brochure Art.png |area=Bonneton |area_subtitle=A land of haberdashed dreams. |population=Middling |size=Smallish |locals=[[Bonneter]]s |currency=Hat-shaped |industry=Hats, Airships |temperature=Average 71°F (22°C) |first_appearance=''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]'' ([[2017]]) }} [[File:SMO Cap Brochure A.png|thumb|left|150px|''Architecture protrudes from the fog.'']] World's Best Hat Stand ''This eye-catching tower is famous in Bonneton, both as a landmark itself and for the spectacular view from the "brim."'' ''Visitors are allowed inside, but many creatures call the tower home, much to the surprise of first timers.'' [[File:SMO Cap Brochure B.png|thumb|200px|''You might mistake them for giants' top hats.'']] Extremely Mobile Homes ''In town, you will immediately notice the unique dwellings shaped like hats. These constructions double as both house and airship for the Bonneters, who take great pride in them.'' ''Some of the larger "houseboats" even have two stories. As private dwellings, you can't just stroll inside, but the natives don't mind people climbing on top of their homes. Perhaps being atop private property comes naturally to these hat-like people.'' {{br}} [[File: SMO Cap Brochure D.png|thumb|left|150px|''The distinctively double-arched bridge.'']] A Spectacle of a Bridge ''The bridge that connects the central square and the hills is called Glasses Bridge. It's a long, double-arched structure whose bottom is hidden in a sea of clouds. When you see it, you'll understand its affectionate nickname immediately. Many tourists enjoy the speedy thrill of [[Roll|rolling]] across the undulating structure—be sure to give it a try!'' [[File: SMO Cap Brochure E.png|thumb|150px|''They also look a bit like hat stands.'']] Old-Fashioned Lighting ''These unique lights only appear in Bonneton. Since the area gets so dark every time the moon goes behind the clouds, the lights are designed to be switched on with a simple turn of the lantern. The elegant design of these lampposts draws many tourists. They're even lovelier when turned on, so do give each one a spin as you pass by.'' [[File: SMO Cap Brochure F.png|thumb|left|150px|''The bridge's waves go with the sea of fog.'']] The "Sometimes" Bridge ''The bridge connecting Central Square to Top-Hat Tower is built to retract in an emergency. If this happens during your visit, don't panic—just use the [[Lever Switch|switch]] to restore the bridge.'' {{br}} [[File: SMO Cap Brochure C.png|thumb|left|50px]] Posts that stand out... ''These wooden [[post]]s are used as partitions or stoppers. If they get in your way, you can pound them down, but pulling them out is recommended.'' {{br}} [[File: SMO Cap Brochure G.png|thumb|350px]] Three Keys to the Kingdom # ''Appreciate the distinctive architectural style based on hat silhouettes.'' # ''Enjoy the romantic glow of the moonlit, fog-shrouded streets.'' # ''Chat with the kind and ever-courteous Bonneters.'' {{br}} ====Map==== [[File:SMO Cap Brochure Map.png|thumb|left|250px]] {{br}} ==Checkpoint Flag locations== ===Odyssey=== [[File:SMO Cap Kingdom Odyssey.jpg|thumb]] {{main|Odyssey}} After obtaining the [[Odyssey]] in the [[Cascade Kingdom]], it will land in the southwest corner of the map where Mario first arrived. {{br}} ===Central Plaza=== [[File:SMO Central Plaza.jpg|thumb]] {{main|Central Plaza}} The [[Central Plaza]] is the main residential area of Bonneton. When Mario first arrives, it is in ruins from [[Bowser]]'s attack. The [[Checkpoint Flag]] does not appear until Mario returns later after the plaza is rebuilt. {{br}} ===Top-Hat Tower=== [[File:SMO Top-Hat Tower.jpg|thumb]] {{main|Top-Hat Tower}} This Checkpoint Flag is found near the top of the Top-Hat Tower next to the doorway where Mario exits the tower's interior. {{br}} ==Sub-areas== {|class="wikitable" text-align="center" !Area !Entrance !Exit |- |align=center|[[File:SMO Cap Coins H.png|200px]]

This disappears when the Cap Kingdom is revisited. ==Power Moons== [[File:SMO Power Moon Yellow.png|thumb|100px|The Cap Kingdom has yellow Power Moons.]] {{main|List of Power Moons in the Cap Kingdom}} There are a total of 31 Power Moons in the Cap Kingdom. During the player's first visit to this kingdom, none of the Power Moons can be collected. After the player finds the Odyssey in the Cascade Kingdom and powers it up, they can return here and collect 11 of the Power Moons. After defeating Bowser in the [[Moon Kingdom]], 6 more Power Moons become available in this kingdom, including one from the kingdom's Hint Art. The Moon Rock will also be available to destroy, unlocking 14 additional Power Moons. {{br}} ==Regional coins== [[File:SMO Cap Regional Coin Screenshot.png|thumb|120px]] {{main|List of regional coins in the Cap Kingdom}} The Cap Kingdom contains 50 [[regional coin]]s, which take the form of top-hats. "''A land of haberdashed dreams.''" |- |- bgcolor="whitesmoke" | '''Population''' | Middling | '''Size''' | Smallish |- | '''Locals''' | [[Bonneter]]s | '''Currency''' | Hat-shaped |- bgcolor="whitesmoke" | '''Industry''' | Hats, Airships | '''Temperature''' | Average 71°F (22°C) |} [[File:SMO Cap Brochure A.png|thumb|left|150px|''Architecture protrudes from the fog.'']] World's Best Hat Stand ''This eye-catching tower is famous in Bonneton, both as a landmark itself and for the spectacular view from the "brim."'' ''Visitors are allowed inside, but many creatures call the tower home, much to the surprise of first timers.'' [[File:SMO Cap Brochure B.png|thumb|200px|''You might mistake them for giants' top hats.'']] Extremely Mobile Homes ''In town, you will immediately notice the unique dwellings shaped like hats. These constructions double as both house and airship for the Bonneters, who take great pride in them.'' ''Some of the larger "houseboats" even have two stories. As private dwellings, you can't just stroll inside, but the natives don't mind people climbing on top of their homes. Perhaps being atop private property comes naturally to these hat-like people.''
[[File: SMO Cap Brochure D.png|thumb|left|150px|''The distinctively double-arched bridge.'']] A Spectacle of a Bridge ''The bridge that connects the central square and the hills is called Glasses Bridge. It's a long, double-arched structure whose bottom is hidden in a sea of clouds. When you see it, you'll understand its affectionate nickname immediately. Many tourists enjoy the speedy thrill of [[Roll|rolling]] across the undulating structure—be sure to give it a try!'' [[File: SMO Cap Brochure E.png|thumb|150px|''They also look a bit like hat stands.'']] Old-Fashioned Lighting ''These unique lights only appear in Bonneton. Since the area gets so dark every time the moon goes behind the clouds, the lights are designed to be switched on with a simple turn of the lantern. The elegant design of these lampposts draws many tourists. They're even lovelier when turned on, so do give each one a spin as you pass by.'' [[File: SMO Cap Brochure F.png|thumb|left|150px|''The bridge's waves go with the sea of fog.'']] The "Sometimes" Bridge ''The bridge connecting Central Square to Top-Hat Tower is built to retract in an emergency. If this happens during your visit, don't panic—just use the [[Lever Switch|switch]] to restore the bridge.''
[[File: SMO Cap Brochure C.png|thumb|left|50px]] Posts that stand out... ''These wooden [[post]]s are used as partitions or stoppers. If they get in your way, you can pound them down, but pulling them out is recommended.''
[[File: SMO Cap Brochure G.png|thumb|350px]] Three Keys to the Kingdom # ''Appreciate the distinctive architectural style based on hat silhouettes.'' # ''Enjoy the romantic glow of the moonlit, fog-shrouded streets.'' # ''Chat with the kind and ever-courteous Bonneters.''

==Checkpoint Flag locations== ===Odyssey=== [[File:SMO Cap Kingdom Odyssey.jpg|thumb]] :''Main article: [[:Odyssey|Odyssey]]'' After obtaining the [[Odyssey]] in the [[Cascade Kingdom]], it will land in the southwest corner of the map where Mario first arrived.
===Central Plaza=== [[File:SMO Central Plaza.jpg|thumb]] :''Main article: [[:Central Plaza|Central Plaza]]'' The [[Central Plaza]] is the main residential area of Bonneton. When Mario first arrives, it is in ruins from [[Bowser]]'s attack. The [[Checkpoint Flag]] does not appear until Mario returns later after the plaza is rebuilt.
===Top-Hat Tower=== [[File:SMO Top-Hat Tower.jpg|thumb]] :''Main article: [[:Top-Hat Tower|Top-Hat Tower]]'' This Checkpoint Flag is found near the top of the Top-Hat Tower next to the doorway where Mario exits the tower's interior.

This disappears when the Cap Kingdom is revisited. ==Power Moons== [[File:SMO Power Moon Yellow.png|thumb|100px|The Cap Kingdom has yellow Power Moons.]] :''Main article: [[:List of Power Moons in the Cap Kingdom|List of Power Moons in the Cap Kingdom]]'' There are a total of 31 Power Moons in the Cap Kingdom. During the player's first visit to this kingdom, none of the Power Moons can be collected. After the player finds the Odyssey in the Cascade Kingdom and powers it up, they can return here and collect 11 of the Power Moons. After defeating Bowser in the [[Moon Kingdom]], 6 more Power Moons become available in this kingdom, including one from the kingdom's Hint Art. The Moon Rock will also be available to destroy, unlocking 14 additional Power Moons.
==Regional coins== [[File:SMO Cap Regional Coin Screenshot.png|thumb|120px]] :''Main article: [[:List of regional coins in the Cap Kingdom|List of regional coins in the Cap Kingdom]]'' The Cap Kingdom contains 50 [[regional coin]]s, which take the form of top-hats. They cannot be collected until the player powers up the Odyssey in the Cascade Kingdom.
